breve: A node that controls how the object faces the camera to be used within the visual shader graph.
descricao: The output port of this node needs to be connected to Model View Matrix port of VisualShaderNodeOutput.

propriedades.desc: Controls how the object faces the camera.
If true, the shader will keep the scale set for the mesh. Otherwise, the scale is lost when billboarding.
